cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies, aged around 23 years, between 32-42 weeks gestational age, matched for age and parity.
finding: Women with AFI <= 5cm had significantly higher rates of non-reactive NST, LSCS (especially emergency LSCS), APGAR score <=7 at 5 min, and NICU admissions compared to those with AFI 6-20 cm.
mod_finding: 90% of cases in the low AFI group underwent LSCS compared to 60% in the control group, and emergency LSCS was also significantly higher in the low AFI group (64.4% vs 40%).
birth_weight: Very low birth weight (reason for NICU admission in 10% of low AFI group newborns)
